and_the_pipelined_divider_is_NOT_the_sec.attribution: the sum pipeline alone is 1.01x on the same 35 matrices, so the whole 54% is the divider
and_the_pipelined_divider_is_NOT_the_sec.so: it is behind PIPELINED_DIVIDER, defaulted off, with the number written down
and_the_pipelined_divider_is_NOT_the_sec.the_lesson: ot_a3_fp32_div_rne_pipe's own bench recorded 1.06x of division TIME on its own stimulus.  A Sinkhorn denominator is a four-element sum plus epsilon and its operands land differently in the seeded bracket, so a ratio measured on one stimulus is not a property of the module.
and_the_pipelined_divider_is_NOT_the_sec.why_it_loses: at 1.55x the cycles the swap needs 1.55x the clock to break even, and 431.4 over 283.5 is 1.52x

not_a_claim: nothing instantiates the twin: the certifying block is unmoved and its bound vectors are unaffected, so this is a qualified replacement and not a shipped one
the 261.1 MHz is this block alone; no whole-chip clock has ever been measured (25 top-level islands, none of them the chip)
question: the routed coverage sweep put ot_a3_hc_sinkhorn20_rne at 196.6 MHz, BELOW the divider's 283.5 -- so it is the datapath's clock limiter.  What is the path, and what does pipelining it cost?

the_path_is_depth_not_fanout.cause: S_SUM computes the whole four-element reduction in ONE cycle as three dependent binary32 adds: (x0+x1) and (x2+x3) in parallel, then their sum, then the contract's epsilon
the_path_is_depth_not_fanout.evidence: every stage on the reported max-delay path drives one to five loads, and the path walks about ninety cells of adder carry and comparison logic from phase[0] to result_codes[375]

the_twin.change: the same three adds on the same values in the same order, separated by registers: S_SUM becomes S_SUM_A (the two independent pair adds), S_SUM_B (their sum) and S_SUM_C (the epsilon add, which latches the denominator)

cycle_cost.arithmetic: two extra cycles per reduction, 39 phases of four groups = 156 reductions = 312 cycles, against 624 divisions of tens of cycles each

equivalence.coverage: uniform one / quarter / smallest normal / largest finite, a row and a column graded by 2**-20, max-finite beside smallest-normal, the four malformed classes the loader refuses (zero, negative, infinite, NaN), and 24 random positive finite matrices

routed_on_asap7.reading: 1.33x the frequency at 0.93x the area and 0.91x the cells, and it CLOSES where the reference did not meet timing at all.  With 1.01x the cycles that is 1.32x the block's throughput.

what_the_limiter_is_now: the datapath's clock limiter rises from 196.6 MHz to 261.1 MHz.  It is still this block, and what remains below it is ot_a3_fp32_div_rne's own 283.5 MHz combinational body -- so ~261 MHz is close to the ceiling this block can reach with that divider inside it, and the cycle-cheap divider needed to pass 283.5 MHz does not exist yet (the pipelined one costs 1.55x the cycles here).
